name: Punchline Showdown
description: Funny prompts, head-to-head answers, class picks the funniest. Each pair shares a prompt; everyone else votes.

intro.message:
PUNCHLINE SHOWDOWN!

You'll be paired with one other player and given a silly prompt. Write the funniest answer you can. Then the rest of the class will vote on which one wins.

prompts.instruction: Generate 8 short, classroom-appropriate, open-ended comedy prompts for a head-to-head punchline game. Each prompt should invite a funny one-line answer. Examples: 'A better name for France:', 'The worst thing to find in your sandwich:', 'A class rule that would make everyone happier:'. Return ONLY a JSON array of 8 strings (no preamble, no code fences).

end.message: GG! Thanks for playing Punchline Showdown.

recommendedFor: Older students who can riff. Works best with even player counts.
